manifest_row.title: Western Canada: The 'summer of repeal' begins in Alberta

screening.main_topic: Alberta's new government's legislative agenda, including the repeal or revision of policies introduced by the previous government.
screening.climate_relevance: The newsletter discusses repealing Alberta's carbon tax, its role in the previous government's climate plan and Canada's national climate strategy, and a planned lower tax on large industrial greenhouse-gas emitters. It also includes commentary on the carbon-tax debate.
screening.reason: Climate policy receives meaningful attention, but it is one part of a broader political newsletter focused on Alberta legislation and other Western Canada news.
